WITH equipment_avgs AS (
  SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) as avg_humidity
  FROM scanenvironment
  WHERE humepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY equipref
),
all_equip_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) as overall_avg
  FROM equipment_avgs
),
kept_equipment AS (
  SELECT ea.equipref, ea.avg_humidity
  FROM equipment_avgs ea
  WHERE ea.avg_humidity > (SELECT overall_avg FROM all_equip_avg)
),
kept_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) as kept_avg
  FROM kept_equipment
),
with_differences AS (
  SELECT 
    ke.equipref,
    ke.avg_humidity,
    ke.avg_humidity - (SELECT overall_avg FROM all_equip_avg) as exceeds_all_avg,
    ABS(ke.avg_humidity - (SELECT kept_avg FROM kept_mean)) as dist_from_kept_mean
  FROM kept_equipment ke
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    equipref,
    avg_humidity,
    exceeds_all_avg,
    dist_from_kept_mean,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN dist_from_kept_mean IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, dist_from_kept_mean DESC) as rn
  FROM with_differences
),
tenth_val AS (
  SELECT dist_from_kept_mean FROM ranked WHERE rn = 10
)
SELECT 
  equipref,
  avg_humidity,
  exceeds_all_avg,
  dist_from_kept_mean
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 10 OR (dist_from_kept_mean IS NOT NULL AND dist_from_kept_mean = (SELECT dist_from_kept_mean FROM tenth_val))
ORDER BY 
  CASE WHEN dist_from_kept_mean IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  dist_from_kept_mean DESC
